title: Add TeX to Uloc
description: Add TeX as a language bucket in the repo uloc metrics classifier (classifyPathForMetrics / LANG_EMOJI), covering .tex and related TeX ecosystem extensions so mit-bestand and print TeX sources are counted in micro-commit and bundle uloc.
summary: Added TeX as a uloc language bucket so `.tex`, `.sty`, `.cls`, `.ltx`, and `.bib` count toward micro-commit and bundle metrics (📐). Bumped uloc cache version to 4 so existing caches invalidate.
